spots.name: Saint Martin
spots.blurb: You've reached Saint Martin, a mural by Gaston Thévoz from 1945. S'il y a une heure pour la charité, il y en a une pour la justice sociale.

spots.name: 10 ans du Pont de la Poya
spots.blurb: You've reached 10 ans du Pont de la Poya, a mural from 2024. Collaborative 96 m long "reverse graffiti" on the retaining wall created by using high pressure cleaner. Lots of different patterns drawn from rural traditions.
